name: EPICross
detailed_description:
About the Game

EPICROSS is a relaxing, colorful 2D picross puzzle game where logic meets creativity. Solve colorful puzzles by filling in grids, using numerical clues to complete each image and uncover a beautiful design. Every level is a unique challenge that stimulates your mind while offering a calming experience. Perfect for puzzle lovers who enjoy relaxing gameplay with a splash of color.

In EPICROSS, each puzzle is more than just a grid—it’s a world of color waiting to come to life. Solve challenging levels, unlock new puzzles, and enjoy a soothing yet engaging experience that’s perfect for all ages.

Features:

  • Colorful Picross Puzzles: Solve 2D puzzles with colors instead of just black and white for a fresh twist.

  • Relaxing Gameplay: No time pressure, just pure puzzle-solving satisfaction.

  • Level Editor: Create and share your own colorful puzzles for others to enjoy.

  • Intuitive Controls: Easy to pick up and play, but challenging enough for seasoned puzzle enthusiasts.

  • Customizable Themes: Choose from a variety of themes to make your puzzle-solving experience more enjoyable.

  • Family-friendly: Suitable for players of all ages—easy to play but hard to master!

Design:

The game features simple, intuitive controls with grid-based puzzles and a focus on colorful solutions. As you progress, the puzzles become more intricate and rewarding, offering a sense of accomplishment with every completed image.

EPICROSS is ideal for players who want to experience a light-hearted, visually stimulating puzzle game without the pressure of time limits.
